invoice_schedules_tanggal_jatuh_tempo.name: invoice_schedules_tanggal_jatuh_tempo
invoice_schedules_tanggal_jatuh_tempo.value:
("invoice_schedules"."aturan_jatuh_tempo" = 'tanggal_masuk' and "invoice_schedules"."tanggal_jatuh_tempo" is null)
        or ("invoice_schedules"."aturan_jatuh_tempo" = 'tanggal_tetap' and "invoice_schedules"."tanggal_jatuh_tempo" is not null
          and "invoice_schedules"."tanggal_jatuh_tempo" between 1 and 28)

payment_attempts_instruksi.name: payment_attempts_instruksi
payment_attempts_instruksi.value: ("payment_attempts"."metode" = 'qris' and "payment_attempts"."qr_string" is not null) or (left("payment_attempts"."metode", 3) = 'va_' and "payment_attempts"."nomor_va" is not null)

wa_conversations_workspace_butuh_user.name: wa_conversations_workspace_butuh_user
wa_conversations_workspace_butuh_user.value: "wa_conversations"."organization_id" is null or "wa_conversations"."user_id" is not null
